question: Consider only books cataloged on or after 2000. For each library material status and department, list the material status, department name, number of associated catalog items, and the total number of enrolled students in courses using those materials. Include subtotals for each material status and a grand total across all status (the corresponding status field is 'Grand Total').
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "catalog_core" AS SELECT "library_reserve_catalog_key" AS "library_reserve_catalog_key", "catalog_title" AS "catalog_title", "catalog_year" AS "catalog_year", "catalog_record_create_date" AS "catalog_record_create_date" FROM beaver."library_reserve_catalog";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "reserve_material_detail" AS SELECT "library_reserve_catalog_key" AS "library_reserve_catalog_key", "library_material_status_key" AS "library_material_status_key", "library_subject_offered_key" AS "library_subject_offered_key", "term_code" AS "term_code", "subject_id" AS "subject_id" FROM beaver."library_reserve_matrl_detail";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "material_status_lu" AS SELECT "library_material_status_key" AS "library_material_status_key", "library_material_status" AS "library_material_status" FROM beaver."library_material_status";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "library_subject_offered" AS SELECT "library_subject_offered_key" AS "library_subject_offered_key", "term_code" AS "term_code", "subject_id" AS "subject_id", "offer_dept_code" AS "offer_dept_code", "offer_dept_name" AS "offer_dept_name", "num_enrolled_students" AS "num_enrolled_students" FROM beaver."library_subject_offered";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    rmd.library_reserve_catalog_key AS catalog_key,
    ms.library_material_status AS material_status,
    lso.offer_dept_name AS department_name,
    c.catalog_year,
    c.catalog_record_create_date,
    COALESCE(lso.num_enrolled_students, 0) AS enrolled
  FROM reserve_material_detail rmd
  JOIN material_status_lu ms
    ON rmd.library_material_status_key = ms.library_material_status_key
  JOIN library_subject_offered lso
    ON rmd.library_subject_offered_key = lso.library_subject_offered_key
  JOIN catalog_core c
    ON rmd.library_reserve_catalog_key = c.library_reserve_catalog_key
), filtered AS (
  SELECT
    catalog_key,
    material_status,
    department_name,
    enrolled
  FROM base
  WHERE (
    catalog_year IS NOT NULL AND CAST(catalog_year AS BIGINT) >= 2000
  ) OR (
    catalog_year IS NULL AND TRY_STRPTIME(catalog_record_create_date, '%d-%b-%y') IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT('year' FROM TRY_STRPTIME(catalog_record_create_date, '%d-%b-%y')) >= 2000
  )
), dedup AS (
  -- Count distinct catalog items per status and department
  SELECT DISTINCT catalog_key, material_status, department_name
  FROM filtered
), counts AS (
  SELECT
    f.material_status,
    f.department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.catalog_key) AS num_catalog_items,
    SUM(f.enrolled) AS total_enrolled_students
  FROM filtered f
  GROUP BY 1,2
), subtotals AS (
  SELECT
    material_status,
    'Subtotal' AS department_name,
    SUM(num_catalog_items) AS num_catalog_items,
    SUM(total_enrolled_students) AS total_enrolled_students
  FROM counts
  GROUP BY 1
), grand AS (
  SELECT
    'Grand Total' AS material_status,
    'Grand Total' AS department_name,
    SUM(num_catalog_items) AS num_catalog_items,
    SUM(total_enrolled_students) AS total_enrolled_students
  FROM counts
)
SELECT * FROM counts
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM subtotals
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM grand
ORDER BY CASE WHEN material_status='Grand Total' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, material_status, department_name;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS

WITH base AS (

    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(ms.library_material_status), ''), 'Unknown') AS material_status,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(lso.offer_dept_name), ''), 'Unknown') AS department_name,
    c.catalog_year,
    c.catalog_record_create_date,
    COALESCE(lso.num_enrolled_students, 0) AS enrolled
  FROM reserve_material_detail rmd
  LEFT JOIN material_status_lu ms
    ON rmd.library_material_status_key = ms.library_material_status_key
  LEFT JOIN library_subject_offered lso

  JOIN catalog_core c
    ON rmd.library_reserve_catalog_key = c.library_reserve_catalog_key
), parsed AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN catalog_year IS NOT NULL AND CAST(catalog_year AS BIGINT) BETWEEN 1000 AND 9999 THEN CAST(catalog_year AS BIGINT)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS year_from_catalog,
    /* Try multiple date formats seen in samples, e.g., 28-SEP-01 */
    COALESCE(
      EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_STRPTIME(catalog_record_create_date, '%d-%b-%y')),
      EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_STRPTIME(catalog_record_create_date, '%d-%b-%Y')),
      EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_STRPTIME(catalog_record_create_date, '%Y-%m-%d'))
    ) AS year_from_create
  FROM base
), filtered AS (
  SELECT
    catalog_key,
    material_status,
    department_name,
    enrolled
  FROM parsed
  WHERE COALESCE(year_from_catalog, year_from_create) >= 2000
), counts AS (
  SELECT
    material_status,
    department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT catalog_key) AS num_catalog_items,
    SUM(enrolled) AS total_enrolled_students
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY 1,2
), subtotals AS (
  SELECT
    material_status,
    'Subtotal' AS department_name,
    SUM(num_catalog_items) AS num_catalog_items,
    SUM(total_enrolled_students) AS total_enrolled_students
  FROM counts
  GROUP BY 1
), grand AS (
  SELECT
    'Grand Total' AS material_status,
    'Grand Total' AS department_name,
    SUM(num_catalog_items) AS num_catalog_items,
    SUM(total_enrolled_students) AS total_enrolled_students
  FROM counts
), unioned AS (
  SELECT material_status, department_name, num_catalog_items, total_enrolled_students FROM counts
  UNION ALL
  SELECT material_status, department_name, num_catalog_items, total_enrolled_students FROM subtotals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT material_status, department_name, num_catalog_items, total_enrolled_students FROM grand
)
SELECT material_status, department_name, num_catalog_items, total_enrolled_students
FROM unioned
ORDER BY CASE WHEN material_status = 'Grand Total' THEN 2 WHEN department_name = 'Subtotal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
         material_status,
         department_name
LIMIT 200;
